scope: Desktop GPU: forced compatibility execution, same 3D numerical tests for each collision path; actual mobile GPU verification is separate.

cases.name: canonical GPU world joint pulls and releases a body
canonical GPU resting contact respects the floor contact margin
GPU sleeping batches passes without changing impact or support state
GPU sleeping preserves poses and real masses, then wakes reciprocal impact bodies
GPU sleeping wakes a dependent when a support moves away
GPU sleeping rejects an unsupported initial configuration
GPU 3D zero-torque motor leaves free angular motion unchanged
GPU 3D sphere casts use rounded faces, edges and hulls rather than inflated boxes
GPU analytic capsules support hull contacts and exact rounded raycasts
GPU analytic capsules detect segment crossings, rounded corners and stable floor support
GPU native 3D hinge and motor initialize their angular records before the first step
GPU 3D hinge permits axial rotation and enforces angle stops with a torque-limited motor
GPU restitution obeys a sphere's bounce coefficient and zero skips bounce passes
GPU elastic sphere collision conserves momentum and kinetic energy
GPU triggers report entry/exit, honor masks, and never deflect motion
GPU sleep eligibility is per body and explicit opt-in enables the policy
Package rotated weld preserves its rest orientation without pose readback
Package live weld captures GPU rotation and joint slots are reused
Package movable world anchor, springs and breakable welds execute on GPU
Babylon springs stretch and return, fracture in tension, and survive compression
Package compact pose gathering copies only requested meshes and preserves order
Package rays use live GPU poses, filters, ignored bodies and convex surfaces
Package contact events begin/end without full pose downloads
Package sleeping wakes for impulses and support removal
Package sleeping wakes on impact and leaves unsupported slow falls awake
Package 2D joints and motors and 3D fabric are available without demo imports

excluded: GPU 2D raycasts and circle casts handle rotated boxes, rounded corners, masks and sensors
GPU analytic capsule collision benchmark against tessellated capsules
GPU 2D triggers preserve motion, honor masks and emit one entry/exit per face
GPU 2D restitution rebounds at the requested speed without face-point amplification
Selected pose gathering supports half-million-body selections
